    Live System Blueprint — Database & API for Inbox, Vault & Back Office

    What this page is: the complete build spec for the live back-end that connects the Client Action Inbox, the Smart Document Vault, and the Professional Back Office. It is a blueprint, not a running server — this static page has no database and no API; the tools on it work in this tab only. When the live back-end is built, it is built to exactly this schema.

    How the sync works (the loop this schema powers)

    1 · Professional requests
    A row in document_requests (status missing) appears in the client's Action Inbox, Tab 1, in their language.
    2 · Client uploads
    The file lands in encrypted storage; a documents row files it under its vault category; the request flips to under_review (green) and a notifications row alerts the professional by their preference.
    3 · Professional decides
    Verify & Accept → request complete. Request Retake → back to missing with the professional's note, and the client is alerted by Email/SMS.

    Database schema (PostgreSQL)

    -- Roles: client | preparer | attorney | nonprofit | admin
CREATE TABLE users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('client','preparer','attorney','nonprofit','admin')),
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, phone TEXT,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,            -- never stored in the web page
  is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,  -- attorneys & DOJ: admin flips this
  notify_pref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' -- in_app | email | sms | all
);
CREATE TABLE client_profiles (
  user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
  full_legal_name TEXT, dob DATE,
  mailing_address TEXT, physical_address TEXT,
  preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',  -- en|es|ht|fr|pt
  service_option TEXT,                     -- DIY|Preparer|Attorney|DOJ Nonprofit
  notify_pref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'both' -- email | sms | both
);
CREATE TABLE professional_profiles (
  user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
  display_name TEXT, public_slug TEXT UNIQUE,     -- /p/[your-company-name]
  bar_number TEXT, states_licensed TEXT[],        -- attorneys
  eoir_number TEXT, accreditation_level TEXT,     -- DOJ: Partial|Full
  accreditation_expiry DATE,
  plan TEXT, accepting_clients BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE
);
CREATE TABLE cases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  assigned_professional_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),  -- row-level isolation key
  forms TEXT[] NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
  uscis_receipt TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE document_requests (           -- Client Action Inbox, Tab 1
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (category IN ('Identity','Relationship Proof','Financial/Tax','Medical/Police','USCIS Notices')),
  instructions_i18n JSONB NOT NULL,        -- plain-language text per language
  requested_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'missing'   -- missing | under_review | complete
    CHECK (status IN ('missing','under_review','complete')),
  retake_note TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE documents (                   -- Smart Document Vault
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  request_id UUID REFERENCES document_requests(id),
  category TEXT NOT NULL, file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,               -- encrypted object storage, signed URLs only
  uploaded_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  review_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'under_review'
);
CREATE TABLE messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  body_original TEXT NOT NULL, original_lang TEXT NOT NULL,
  body_english TEXT,                       -- auto-translation for the professional
  attachment_document_id UUID REFERENCES documents(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), read_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- in_app | email | sms
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- message|document|payment|signature|appointment
  payload JSONB, sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('service_fee','uscis_fee')),
  label TEXT, amount_cents INT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',  -- pending | paid
  stripe_payment_intent TEXT, receipt_url TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE signatures (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id), form_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  signed_name TEXT NOT NULL, signed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE appointments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- phone | video | in_person
  starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, topic TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE exhibits (                    -- Relationship Evidence Book
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  document_id UUID REFERENCES documents(id),
  exhibit_date DATE NOT NULL, caption TEXT, kind TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE milestones (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- biometrics|medical|interview|i751|n400|ead_renewal
  due_date DATE NOT NULL
);
-- Row-Level Security: a user sees a case ONLY if they are its client
-- or its assigned professional. Unassigned professionals see zero rows.
ALTER TABLE cases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY case_isolation ON cases USING (
  client_id = auth.uid() OR assigned_professional_id = auth.uid());

    API endpoints (back-end only — keys & secrets never in the page)

    EndpointWhat it does
    GET /api/client/inboxThe signed-in client's 3 Action Inbox tabs + unread badge counts (missing, messages, payments/signatures).
    POST /api/documents/upload-urlReturns a short-lived signed upload URL for one inbox card; the file goes straight to encrypted storage under its vault category.
    POST /api/documents/:id/confirmMarks the upload filed, flips its request to under_review, and notifies the assigned professional by their preference.
    POST /api/pro/documents/:id/acceptVerify & Accept — request becomes complete; client notified.
    POST /api/pro/documents/:id/retakeRequest Retake {note} — request returns to missing with the note; client alerted by Email/SMS.
    GET /api/cases/:id/thread · POST /api/cases/:id/messagesTwo-way thread. On POST, the message is stored with its original language, translated for the other side, and routed by both sides' notification preferences.
    POST /api/cases/:id/signReview & E-Sign Gate — records the client's signature and clears Pre-Flight Lock item (d).
    POST /api/cases/:id/appointmentsBooks phone / video / in-person against the assigned professional's availability.
    GET /api/cases/:id/packet.pdf · GET /api/cases/:id/evidence-book.pdfServer-generated Complete Packet PDF and the chronological Exhibit Packet with Table of Contents.
    POST /api/admin/verifications/:userIdAdmin only — after checking a bar number or EOIR roster entry, sets is_verified = true and activates the public storefront.
    POST /api/uscis/case-statusThe only route that talks to USCIS — Client ID/Secret stay in server environment variables, never in the browser.

    Auth: every route requires the signed-in user's token, and the database's row-level policy — not the page — enforces that a client sees only their own case and a professional only cases assigned to them.
